items.q: What matters more — daily protein or workout timing?
items.a: **Total daily protein is the cake**; timing relative to training is a **very thin layer of icing**. Aim roughly **0.7–1 g/lb/day** (~1.66 g/kg when optimized); if you're still burping your pre-workout meal, don't sprint to a shaker.

items.q: How long is the real anabolic window?
items.a: A single lift elevates muscle protein synthesis for **24–72 hours**, not 30–60 minutes. Pre- vs post-workout protein — and even **±3 hours of nutrient neglect** — show no meaningful difference when daily protein is dialed in.

items.q: Is the "30 g protein max per meal" rule real?
items.a: That rule confuses digestion with MPS. After high-volume training, **40 g beats 20 g**; a practical per-meal ceiling is about **0.2–0.25 g/lb** (~0.4–0.6 g/kg). Dinner-heavy stacking is fine for most people.

items.q: Does fasted training burn more fat overall?
items.a: Fasted work burns **more body fat during the bout**, but with equated daily nutrition, **24-hour fat oxidation evens out**. Aragon/Schoenfeld's RCT found **no body-comp difference** fed vs fasted — preference rules.

items.q: Can you gain muscle and lose fat at the same time?
items.a: Yes — **body recomposition is real** across at least ~12 studies. Common thread: **1–1.5 g/lb protein** plus resistance training; often without a caloric deficit. Antonio overfeeding: stack **50–100 g protein/day** on habitual intake → thermic effect, little or no fat gain.

items.q: Do plant proteins match animal for muscle?
items.a: Animal proteins win **gram-for-gram on leucine density**; soy is competitive. **Pea + mycoprotein (Quorn)** can match whey when leucine/EAA are equated in head-to-head trials.

items.q: Are seed oils as bad as social media claims?
items.a: Vilification is overblown. In meta-analysis, **canola often beats olive oil for lowering LDL**; context (hyper-palatable UPFs) matters more than oil type alone. Added sugar cap ~**50 g/day** (WHO).

items.q: Do diet sodas sabotage fat loss?
items.a: Controlled trials show diet sodas are a **net positive for weight loss** vs water for dieters. **Saccharin** is the outlier for gut/glucose harm signals — not a blanket indictment of all artificial sweeteners.

items.q: Which supplements does Aragon actually stack?
items.a: Practical stack: **vitamin D3**, fish oil ~**1 g EPA/DHA**, magnesium citrate, **creatine monohydrate 5 g**, vitamin C. **Collagen ~15 g/day** for connective tissue/skin — not for MPS (poor leucine).

Aragon favors **4–5× resistance training**, short rests, **cluster sets and supersets**, with minimal dedicated cardio. Women's dieters can align a **diet-break week** with the menstrual week to reduce craving fights.
